meaning:
χλωρός, -ά, -όν
(χλόη), [in LXX for יֶרֶק, etc. ;]
(a) pale green: χόρτος, Mrk.6:39, Rev.8:7; πᾶν χ., Rev.9:4;
(b) pale: ἵππος, Rev.6:8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword…
